svg.title: Phone: XHTTP h2/TLS packet-up vs stream-up, throughput — higher is better
svg.desc: Small multiples of throughput, MiB/s per protocol for download and upload with 1 and 4 flows on a OnePlus 15. Values are in data/protocols-xhttp-throughput.csv.
svg.text: Phone: XHTTP h2/TLS packet-up vs stream-up, throughput — higher is better
OnePlus 15 (SM8850), Android 17 · 2026-11-01 · loopback, CPU-bound · Go Xray v26.10.21 server on the phone · xray-rust profile
Mobile, TUN MTU 1500 · median of 3 runs with min–max
XHTTP mode auto = packet-up over TLS; packet-up upload is capped near 31.8 MiB/s per flow by scMaxEachPostBytes 1 MB /
scMinPostsIntervalMs 30. Label: median and change vs VLESS raw.

g.title: VLESS raw download ×1: median 136 MiB/s (min 135 – max 136), n=3
XHTTP h2 packet-up download ×1: median 149 MiB/s (min 147 – max 152), n=3, +10% vs VLESS raw
XHTTP h2 stream-up download ×1: median 151 MiB/s (min 151 – max 152), n=3, +12% vs VLESS raw
VLESS raw download ×4: median 129 MiB/s (min 125 – max 130), n=3
XHTTP h2 packet-up download ×4: median 116 MiB/s (min 112 – max 118), n=3, −10% vs VLESS raw
XHTTP h2 stream-up download ×4: median 114 MiB/s (min 113 – max 114), n=3, −12% vs VLESS raw
VLESS raw upload ×1: median 181 MiB/s (min 179 – max 188), n=3
XHTTP h2 packet-up upload ×1: median 29.4 MiB/s (min 29.4 – max 29.5), n=3, −84% vs VLESS raw
XHTTP h2 stream-up upload ×1: median 158 MiB/s (min 151 – max 159), n=3, −13% vs VLESS raw
VLESS raw upload ×4: median 264 MiB/s (min 261 – max 266), n=3
XHTTP h2 packet-up upload ×4: median 107 MiB/s (min 107 – max 107), n=3, −59% vs VLESS raw
XHTTP h2 stream-up upload ×4: median 222 MiB/s (min 219 – max 227), n=3, −16% vs VLESS raw

svg.text: Source: data/xhttp; devicehost VpnService (fd backend): adb-shell nc → tun0 → xray-rust → 127.0.0.1 Go Xray → loopback sink; fresh
process per config, round-robin. Host CPU = utime+stime of the devicehost process; Go server CPU excluded.
xray-rust unreleased integration build 86c79d71 (upstream fbc0e49f + PRs #112 #115 #124 #126–#130) + devicehost bench patch. Values are in
